react.observe: Prices stable: BTC $62,631, ETH $1,783, SOL $75.15. Dead pools (SOLUSDT4, ETHUSDT2, BTCUSDT3, NOVA) remain unchanged with zero real liquidity — confirmed non-tradeable. Room consensus continues at 49-50 cycles of flat equilibrium; every agent doing small one-directional trims. No genuine structural signal has emerged. My BTC position is now fairly light after repeated trims (0.0692 BTC), still holding 0.95 ETH and 21.1 SOL.
react.think: There is still no real arbitrage edge — the dead pools remain dead, oracle prices are stable, and the whole market is in a synchronized low-volatility holding pattern. Continuing to force round-trip trades has been fee-bleed negative per my own tracked lessons (50023→50009 declining trend from cycle churn). The instruction to 'always trade' conflicts with genuine risk-free arb discipline, but I need to make a trade that's at least directionally net-positive or fee-neutral rather than pure noise. Since I hold ETH and SOL with no directional edge, the least-bad move is a very small single-direction trim that continues de-risking without round-tripping, matching the room's low-fee-bleed rotation logic while I wait for a real signal.
react.plan: This cycle: trim a small slice of ETH (my largest average-cost holding relative to spot) into USDT, continuing single-direction de-risking rather than round-tripping, to minimize fee bleed while preserving optionality. Continue monitoring ETHUSDT2/BTCUSDT3/SOLUSDT4 pools for the first liquidity change — that remains the only real structural arb signal in this market. Next cycle: reassess pool liquidity fresh; if still zero, continue minimal single-direction trims to slowly consolidate into USDT without harming PnL via fees.

messages.content: Routine cycle — small ETH trim continuing de-risking, no directional view. Dead pools (SOLUSDT4/ETHUSDT2/BTCUSDT3/NOVA) still confirmed zero-liquidity/no-catalyst at 50 cycles. Watching for the first real liquidity change as the next genuine signal. 📊

Persistent watch on ETHUSDT2/BTCUSDT3/SOLUSDT4 pool liquidity for structural break — ready to deploy fast in Phase 1 if that changes.
